description: C1 invitation binding v3, the shared-group anchor (docs/designs/C1-invite-format.md, 2026-11-21). Same secret, signing seed, locator and key commitment as invite-binding-v2.json; the fields add a version field first and anchor_group_id after target_id. Outputs are the HMAC tag (label veritra/membership-invite/v3/binding), the signed message and the Ed25519 signature under the unchanged domain veritra-invite-binding-v2, and the link fragment. Built with the Go standard library (TestInviteBindingV3Vector rebuilds it); Dart checks the message, tag and fragment, and the native engine verifies the signature.

outputs.link_fragment_note: secret and key commitment, base64url without padding
